name: browser-use
headline: My-Claude-Agent-Skills: Modular Skill Packages
short_description: A modular collection of specialized skills extending Claude agent capabilities with domain expertise, tool integrations, and workflow automation across development, research, and automation domains.
author: trotsky1997

sections.overview:
My-Claude-Agent-Skills is a structured collection of reusable skill packages that enhance Claude agent functionality with specialized knowledge and workflows. The skills are organized by domain—including development tools, Python utilities, browser automation, and research methodologies—each providing step-by-step instructions and bundled resources. Skills follow a standardized structure with core definitions in SKILL.md files and optional supporting scripts, references, and assets. This modular approach enables AI agents to automatically trigger relevant skills based on task descriptions, improving agent performance and consistency. The collection supports setup by cloning the repository and configuring your AI agent to recognize skills from the designated location.
Automating code analysis and refactoring using ast-grep rules
Debugging Python code without IDE support using specialized toolkits
Publishing Python packages to PyPI with guided workflows
Browser automation tasks using Vibium or MCP protocol integration
This workflow automates the data processing and reporting for GreenTech Solutions, a renewable energy company. It integrates data from their CRM, ERP, and IoT devices to generate daily performance reports.
